sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 98 x 68 x 25.5 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Shure SLX-D spec sheet, SLXD1 digital wireless bodypack transmitter (downloaded, read as text on 2026-11-12): audio input 4-pin male mini connector (TA4M), unbalanced, 1 megohm; dimensions 98 x 68 x 25.5 mm (H x W x D as printed, "3.86 x 2.68 x 1.0 in"), 89 g; 2 AA batteries or a rechargeable Li-Ion pack. The sheet prints H x W x D, so the plan size (98 long, 68 wide, 25.5 thick) is a body-pack lying flat; the antenna, IR sync port, charge contacts and the power switch are not modelled (no catalogue signal for RF or DC).

build: a moulded box with a lid seam at 11 mm, exact bounding box; the real housing shape (rounded, battery door) was not drawn from a photo or drawing, so the rounding is an ESTIMATE (confidence guess). The TA4M port is on the short end face (guess).
build.projection top and io: our own generic artwork: a display, a rotary and a button on the top face, the mini connector on the end face; no photo, no logo, no lettering.
